title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Hamas leader to push Gaza peace plan
description: The rare meeting comes a week after Israel rejected Donald Trump's peace plan for Gaza.

title: Actress Hayden Panettiere dies aged 36, US media report
description: A representative for the actress confirmed the news to US outlet ABC News, but did not provide further details of her death.

title: UK to turn cooler with rain after exceptional heat and dry spell
description: After and exceptional summer of heatwaves and drought, the weather will turn wetter and cooler this week, as Simon King explains
